data.name: Mubarik
data.gender_notes: Mubarik is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Allah, bestowed with blessings. The name Mubarik carries the meaning “Blessed, fortunate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mubarik usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed, fortunate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies the blessing of Allah upon a person
data.etymology: Mubarik belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed, fortunate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mubarik total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مبارك
in_arabic.meaning: مبارك يعني المبارك عليه، الموفق للخير، المثمر للصلاح
in_arabic.long_meaning: مبارك هو اسم مشتق من البارك الذي يعني البركة والخير الكثير، وهو من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، ويعني الشخص الذي يحظى بالبركة والتوفيق من الله تعالى، ويتميز حامله بالخير الكثير والصلاح

in_urdu.name: مبارک
in_urdu.meaning: مبارک کا مطلب ہے مبارک ہو، محفوظ، برکت والا، اچھائی کا باعث
in_urdu.long_meaning: مبارک ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے برکت والا یا مبارک ہو۔ یہ نام مبارک علیہ کے معنی میں ہے جو اچھائی اور برکت کا باعث ہوتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں اس نام کی تاریخی اہمیت ہے اور یہ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں روایتی اہمیت رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: मुबारक
in_hindi.meaning: मुबारक का अर्थ है आशीर्वादित, भाग्यशाली, सुख-समृद्धि का कारण
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुबारक एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है आशीर्वादित या सुख-समृद्धि का कारण। यह नाम मुबारक عليه के अर्थ में है जो अच्छाई और समृद्धि का कारण होता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का पारंपरिक महत्व है

in_pashto.name: مبارک
in_pashto.meaning: مبارک د برکت معنی ورکوي، په خيرکې برکت لرونکی، مبارک
in_pashto.long_meaning: مبارک د عربي ژبې يو نوم دى چې د برکت او خير د معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د مبارک عليه د معنی په کې دی چې د الله تعالی څخه د برکت او توفيق حصول کوونکی دی. په افغان او پښتون دود کې دا نوم ديني او کلتوري اهميت لري

in_english.name: Mubarik
in_english.meaning: Mubarik means blessed, fortunate, or one who brings good fortune
in_english.long_meaning: Mubarik is an Arabic name derived from the root 'B-R-K' which signifies blessings, goodness, and prosperity. The name Mubarik implies one who is blessed or favored by God. It is mentioned in the Quran and holds significant spiritual and cultural value in Islamic tradition, symbolizing good fortune and divine blessings

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mubarak," derived from the Arabic roots "mubarak" meaning "blessed," is believed to bring good fortune and positive vibrations not only to the person bearing the name but also to the communities and environments they inhabit. This name is commonly used as a term of respect, honor, and admiration in many Islamic cultures, reflecting the blessings of God upon an individual's life.
data.spiritual_significance: This name carries a significant spiritual weight in Islamic tradition as it underscores the human understanding of God's boundless mercy and constant blessings upon all of His creations. Given as a name, it serves as a daily reminder of the role of seeking and receiving God's blessings in one's life and inspires one to live a life worthy of being called "Mubarak" by others. Ultimately, the name "Mubarak" represents a deep spiritual connection between the individual and the Divine, reinforcing the belief that every moment and experience is an opportunity to be blessed by Allah and express gratitude for His countless favors.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Blessed, fortunate" symbolizes From Allah, bestowed with blessings. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mubarik serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of blessed, fortunate.
